about: T-529 (DRAFT): THE UNITY BOOK's lens -- L and R turn every page in place between NIGHT (the night half's words, emerald sepia), WHOLE (full colour) and DAWN (the dawn half's words, sapphire cyanotype); BALANCE stays whole in every setting; turning back returns to the same entry. The book's pages are private: file the sheets with qashot --private. The theatre's debug scratch save; the watch and the lens put back.
